title: Independent same-horizon temporal refinement for the frozen irrigation pulse

depends_on.RM20: production temporal certificate remains far above inherited budget even after forcing-switch decomposition
depends_on.RM21: single raw solves from the frozen origin converge at 8.64, 4.32 and 2.16 s but fail at 1.08 s

question: What endpoint difference is obtained when the same 8.64 s physical irrigation horizon is integrated as one 8.64 s Richards step, two sequential 4.32 s steps, and four sequential 2.16 s steps, without using the production temporal certificate or HEAD_BUDGET in the solve?

frozen_case.initial_state: same -75 cm top-origin profile as RM20/RM21

required_outputs: convergence status of every sequential substep
final pressure-head profile for every complete sequence
max absolute endpoint head difference one-step versus two-half
max absolute endpoint head difference two-half versus four-quarter
max absolute endpoint water-content difference for the same comparisons
ponding and top/bottom flux endpoint differences
an observed refinement ratio if both refined sequences complete
hypotheses: The two-half sequence completes because the first 4.32 s solve is known to converge and its accepted endpoint may move the second half away from the frozen-origin nonlinear failure regime.
The four-quarter sequence may or may not complete; its outcome is scientific evidence and must not be forced.

If both refined sequences complete, their same-horizon endpoint differences provide an independent temporal-discretization scale that does not depend on the production temporal certificate or inherited 1e-5 cm budget.
If four-quarter fails, the one-versus-two-half difference remains evidence but no asymptotic convergence-order claim is allowed.
failure_rule: Do not alter solver tolerances, forcing, horizon, state, boundary modes or use HEAD_BUDGET to influence the raw solves. A failed sequential substep is a scientific numerical result.
nonclaims: RM23 does not set or calibrate a production temporal tolerance.
RM23 does not imply that the finest tested sequence is exact.
RM23 does not admit the three-model triangle.
RM23 does not authorize temporal-history reseeding.
